name: Portside
description: A sidebar for your tab groups, with pinned tabs, a command bar, and tabs that tidy themselves up. Everything stays on this computer.

copy-url.description: Copy the current tab's link, without tracking codes

command-bar.description: Open the command bar over the current tab

last-tab.description: Jump back to the tab you were on before

next-space.description: Go to the next tab group

previous-space.description: Go to the previous tab group

pin-tab.description: Pin or unpin the current tab

clear-today.description: Archive every unpinned tab in this tab group
